scenes.heading: How binary search works
scenes.subheading: Find an item fast in a sorted list
scenes.narration: Welcome! Today we will learn binary search. It finds an item in a sorted list very quickly.

scenes.heading: Halve the list each time
scenes.narration: Start with 16 sorted numbers. Each check looks at the middle and drops the half that cannot hold our number. So 16 becomes 8, then 4, then 2, and then we find it!

scenes.heading: Binary search in Python
scenes.narration: First we work out mid, the middle of the part we still search. If the item at mid equals the target, we return mid. If it is too small, we move low past mid and loop again.

scenes.heading: Recap
scenes.subheading: Check the middle, drop half, repeat
scenes.narration: To recap, binary search checks the middle and throws away half each time. Even a list of one million items needs only about twenty checks. Just remember, the list must be sorted first!
